svg.title: Earth / Mars telemetry
svg.desc: Left half is Earth in cool space blues with a spinning ASCII globe. Right half is Mars in dust and rust, with the Perseverance rover on the surface. The Deep Space Network arc is the only bridge. GitHub stats sit on one shared console.

g.text: Python, C, C++, Java · HTML, CSS, JSON, Markdown · linkedin.com/in/arnav-singh7 · arnavsingh0.github.io
